description: Solo participant in Jeddah creating an interactive, web-based Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. Combining custom artwork, visual storytelling, and interactive explanations to make space science engaging and accessible for future explorers.
summary: Outpost Zero is an interactive web-based application designed to bridge the gap between space education and immersive technical simulation. By gamifying resource management and environmental challenges in a deep-space setting, the platform empowers students and space enthusiasts to explore the complex trade-offs of survival systems such as balancing power grid stability, life support, and structural shielding inspired by authentic space exploration demands.
details:
What it does & how it works:

Outpost Zero is an interactive web-based simulation platform designed to make deep-space survival and resource management tangible and engaging. Functioning directly inside the browser, the application challenges users to maintain operational stability in an extreme environment by managing critical trade-offs—such as power distribution, life support sustainability, and structural integrity. Every user action dynamically alters the system state, turning complex aerospace engineering constraints into an intuitive, hands-on interactive experience.

Benefits and intended impact:

The project bridges the gap between complex space exploration telemetry and accessible public education. Its primary impact is sparking curiosity in space sciences, systems engineering, and resource conservation among students and tech enthusiasts. By turning abstract mission challenges into an interactive game-like interface, it encourages critical thinking about how real-world astronauts and mission control teams prioritize survival under strict physical limitations.

Tools, coding languages, and software used:

  • Core Technologies: HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript for the application logic and responsive interface.
  • Development & Collaboration: Built and structured independently by Malathe Al-Jaidi, serving as project lead, software engineer, and system tester, utilizing Claude and ChatGPT as AI co-pilots for architectural structuring, logic refinement, and UI optimization.
  • Infrastructure & Version Control: Version-controlled via GitHub and deployed globally via Vercel for high-speed, seamless accessibility.

Creativity and design considerations:

Outpost Zero stands out through its focus on friction-free accessibility and clean, atmospheric UI design. Unlike traditional educational tools that rely on static text or heavy downloads, this project delivers an immediate, browser-first atmospheric experience.

When building it, key considerations included:

  1. Performance & Optimization: Ensuring lightweight execution so the app loads instantly on any device without lagging.
  2. User Experience (UX): Designing a clean feedback loop where players immediately see the consequences of their resource allocation choices.
  3. AI-Assisted Workflow: Leveraging artificial intelligence tools strategically to accelerate rapid prototyping, debug core logic loops, and polish the user interface within tight hackathon timeframes.
